name: Nijimi Tenugui
description: A handmade, organic store theme for a small tenugui dye workshop by the river in the fictional town of Kawasoe, pour-dyeing (chusen) cotton tenugui cloths in indigo since 1962, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Pale indigo paper pages, an indigo wash for panels, deep indigo ink text and one muted dyer's blue; Kiwi Maru for display, Mona Sans for text. The hero and the cloth and pour pictures are calm 2D flat raster illustrations (WebP; solid shapes, no outlines, repeat-pattern feel); the four pattern swatches are small geometric SVG tiles; product pictures are photographs. A floating pill header in pale indigo carries the menu, the account link and the cart (H10). The home page is an unfolding cloth (L13): one illustration of a tenugui stays pinned on the left while the chapters scroll beside it, and it changes from folded to opened to hung as each chapter comes into view; then a shelf of four cloths, the pour (paste, pour, rinse) as a wide flat illustration, the dye notes and care, and the journal. The footer opens with a strip of four cloth patterns cropped square (F8), then the name, the menu, the workshop address and hours. Pages: Shop, Patterns (the four stencil repeats with their meanings), How to use & care, The workshop (people, the dye week, visiting), Journal, Newsletter and Contact. The workshop details and the dye notes and care each live in one synced pattern (the care card shows in short form on the home page, in full on How to use & care and beside add-to-cart on every product); each cloth's specifications are product attributes (size, dye, cotton, method, ends), and size and dye print under every price (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop shows a static shelf and orders go by email).

summary.zh-TW: 安靜的日式手拭巾染坊商店：扁平向量插畫中的手巾會隨捲動摺起、展開、晾乾，附花紋說明與使用保養。
summary.en: A calm store for a small tenugui dye workshop: a flat illustrated cloth folds, opens and hangs as you scroll, with patterns and care.
summary.ja: 小さな手ぬぐい染め工房のための静かなストア。スクロールで畳む・広げる・干す手ぬぐいの平面イラスト、柄の解説とお手入れ付き。
summary.fr: Une boutique calme pour un petit atelier de tenugui : un tissu en illustration plate se plie, s'ouvre et sèche au fil du défilement.
summary.de: Ein ruhiger Shop für eine kleine Tenugui-Färberei: ein flach illustriertes Tuch faltet sich beim Scrollen auf und hängt zum Trocknen.

deviation: Codes: none (H10 + F8 + L13 as planned; combination unused: Asa Linen is H8/F8/L13, Hikari App H10/F2/L6, Tsuki Silver H10/F12/L11; L13 is also used by Wagu Mono and Eda Bonsai). Neighbours: Kinari Soba (H11/F6/L6, green light) and Hogusu Physio share no code or palette family. Palette as planned (pale indigo #EEF0F4, indigo wash #D9DEE8, deep indigo ink #1F2433, muted dyer's blue #4A5A7D) with added colours: dyer's blue is 6.0:1 on paper and 5.1:1 on the wash, used for rules, numerals, emphasis and the label square; links and small labels use deep dyer's blue #3A4867 (8.0:1 / 6.8:1); secondary text slate #4F586C (6.3:1 / 5.3:1); body ink #1F2433 is 13.6:1 on paper; buttons are deep indigo pills with paper text; cloth-white cards #F7F8FA and a hairline #C3CAD8 were added. H10 differs from Hikari App and Tsuki Silver by a pale indigo-wash pill with a folded-cloth mark before the Kiwi Maru wordmark and the mini cart as a paper-coloured pill at its end. F8 differs from Asa Linen (photographs) by four 2D flat pattern swatches (seigaiha, asanoha, mameshibori, shima) cropped square in one full-width row, linking to Patterns, over an indigo-wash footer. L13 differs from Asa Linen's linen chapters, Wagu Mono and Eda Bonsai: one pinned flat illustration of the same cloth changes from folded to opened to hung as the three chapters scroll past (assets/js/unfold.js; without it the folded cloth stays; on phones the three stages sit in a row). Fonts verified against google/fonts OFL.txt: Kiwi Maru (Regular, Medium) is OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name and is subset to Latin WOFF2; Mona Sans has the Reserved Font Name "Mona", so it ships unmodified as the upstream variable TTF (wdth 75-125, wght 200-900). Kiwi Maru has no italic, so emphasis in headings is a change of blue instead. Industry tenugui-textiles is new; page tags patterns and how-to-use-and-care are new (The workshop uses about). 4 raster 2D flat illustrations (WebP, Grok Build image_gen via scripts/grok-image.sh), 4 small geometric pattern-tile SVGs and 9 photographs generated with Grok Build and checked by eye for text, marks and logos. Deviation: the four pattern swatches stay geometric SVG tiles (repeat patterns, not scenes) to keep the image budget.
